cli.intro: OpenPDF — create, inspect, merge, split and extract PDFs without external tools.

cmd.open: Open a PDF in the platform's default viewer, or print the command with --print
cmd.capabilities: Print what this build supports, honestly
cmd.inspect: Show version, pages, metadata, page sizes and outlines
cmd.outline: Print the outline tree with entry count and nesting depth
cmd.merge: Concatenate PDF files in argument order
cmd.split: Write one file per page range or per N pages
cmd.arrange: Reorder, remove and rotate pages into a new PDF
cmd.delete-pages: Remove the selected pages into a new PDF
cmd.duplicate-pages: Repeat the selected pages directly after themselves
cmd.insert-pages: Insert every page of another PDF after a selected page
cmd.insert-blank-pages: Insert blank pages after a selected page
cmd.replace-pages: Replace the selected pages with every page of another PDF
cmd.reverse-pages: Reverse the page order into a new PDF
cmd.extract-pages: Keep only the selected pages, in source order, in a new PDF
cmd.rotate: Add a clockwise rotation to the selected pages
cmd.set-page-boxes: Write a CropBox on the selected pages
cmd.set-metadata: Copy every page and rewrite the information dictionary
cmd.bookmarks: Copy every page and replace the outline with the given bookmarks
cmd.fill-form: Copy every page and fill AcroForm field values
cmd.create: Create a PDF with styled text pages
cmd.stamp: Paint a text watermark, header or footer onto selected pages
cmd.extract-text: Extract text from content streams, including compressed ones
cmd.search: Search extracted text line by line
cmd.extract-images: Write embedded JPEG and PNG-encodable images to a directory

opt.print: Print the viewer command without launching it
opt.title: Document title
opt.overwrite: Replace the output file when it already exists
opt.stdin: Read the PDF from standard input instead of a file path
opt.image-stem: File stem for images extracted from standard input, default stdin
opt.every: Split into consecutive files of N pages each
opt.rotate: Clockwise rotation to add to every page: 90, 180 or 270
opt.times: Copies written for each selected page (default 2)
opt.after: Insert after this one-based page; 0 puts the pages first
opt.count: Number of blank pages to insert, 1 to 100 (default 1)
opt.blank-size: Page size for blanks: a3, a4, a5, letter, legal, tabloid or WIDTHxHEIGHT (default: match the source's first page)
opt.limit: Maximum number of matches to report (default 100, max 500)
opt.whole-word: Only match whole words on letter, digit or underscore boundaries
opt.skip: Discard this many matches before reporting any
opt.degrees: Clockwise rotation for the selected pages: 90, 180 or 270
opt.box: CropBox corners in points as left,bottom,right,top
opt.author: Document author, empty text deletes it
opt.subject: Document subject, empty text deletes it
opt.keywords: Document keywords, empty text deletes it
opt.creator: Document creator, empty text deletes it
opt.producer: Document producer, empty text deletes it
opt.page: Page text; use | for a line break (repeatable)
opt.page-size: Paper size: a3, a4, a5, letter, legal, tabloid or WIDTHxHEIGHT
opt.font: Base-14 font: helvetica, helvetica-bold, times, times-bold, courier or courier-bold
opt.font-size: Body or stamp font size in points
opt.align: Text alignment: left, center or right
opt.page-numbers: Draw a page / total footer on every page
opt.position: Stamp position: center, top/header or bottom/footer
opt.stamp-rotation: Clockwise rotation for a centered stamp, -180 to 180
opt.depth: Zero-based nesting level for the bookmarks, default 0
opt.outline-depth: Drop outline entries deeper than this level
opt.set: Field value as Name=Value (repeatable); true and false become booleans
